The Coca-Cola Company is a beverage company that manufactures and sells a wide variety of nonalcoholic drinks across the globe. Its core business is organized around several major beverage categories, which include its flagship Trademark Coca-Cola and other sparkling soft drinks, water, sports drinks, coffee, tea, juice, value-added dairy, plant-based beverages, and emerging beverage categories. - Ticker symbol: KO.
- Stock exchange: New York Stock Exchange (NYSE).

When searching for the shares, using KO is usually the quickest approach. Adding NYSE: KO can help distinguish the listing from other securities or businesses with similar names.

Coca-Cola is therefore an NYSE-listed stock, not a stock listed on the Nasdaq exchange. CNBC identifies the security as Coca-Cola Co KO:NYSE, confirming the exchange designation.[3]
